svg.title: Plan · measurement first input contract plan
svg.desc: Replace the Croce-constrained entrance with the four-dataset unified measurement loader and make all teacher families optional sidecars.
svg.text: Plan · measurement first input contract plan
Replace the Croce-constrained entrance with the four-dataset unified measurement loader and make all teacher families optional sidecars.

g.title: Unified measured local view
g.desc: Unified measured local view; unified window → local anchor; 20 s crop · 10 boundary patches; scope inference; implementation implemented; Use UnifiedPhysiologyWindowDataset for every newly planned experiment
